findings.current: Then our Lord will take you as his servant.
findings.defect: The Korean 종 denotes being taken as a slave, so “servant” softens the coercive status and threat.
findings.rationale: The Death Knights are offering subjugation, not ordinary employment or voluntary service.
findings.replacement: Then our Lord will take you as his slave.

findings.current: The dark blade had barely cleared its scabbard before it was forced back inside.
findings.defect: “Barely cleared its scabbard” says the blade had already emerged, while the source says it returned before it had even been drawn.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes that the sword was stopped almost before the draw began.
findings.replacement: The dark blade had barely begun to emerge from its scabbard before it slid back inside.

findings.current: A soldier in a crooked combat helmet stared at the sky with lifeless eyes.
findings.defect: “Combat helmet” drops the source's specific detail that the soldier wore a bulletproof helmet.
findings.rationale: 방탄 specifies bulletproof protection, not merely a combat-style helmet.
findings.replacement: A soldier in a crooked bulletproof helmet stared at the sky with lifeless eyes.

findings.current: Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department lay dead
findings.defect: The current states their identity as certain, omitting the source's indication that they only appeared or were presumed to be Hunters from that department.
findings.rationale: The Korean uses 짐작되는, preserving uncertainty about who the dead were.
findings.replacement: Those who appeared to be Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces Department lay dead

findings.defect: “Beyond recognition” adds a stronger condition than the source establishes. The source says they were not intact or whole, not that they were unrecognizable.
findings.rationale: 온전치 못한 모습 describes damaged, incomplete bodies without asserting loss of recognizability.

findings.current: So many died. So damn many.
findings.defect: The added profanity intensifies the narration beyond the source's repetition of “many,” which expresses shock without vulgarity.
findings.rationale: 정말로 means “really,” not “damn”; the source's emotional force comes from repetition rather than profanity.
findings.replacement: So many died. Really, so many.

findings.current: A Dullahan charged through the spray of foul-smelling brain matter, only to be cleaved in half with a single blow.
findings.defect: The current changes the physical image: the source has the Dullahan charging while being drenched or covered in foul-smelling brain matter, not merely moving through a spray.
findings.rationale: 뒤집어쓰며 describes brain matter being thrown over the Dullahan and covering it.
findings.replacement: A Dullahan came charging at me, drenched in foul-smelling brain matter, only to be cleaved in half with a single blow.

summary: Several localized fidelity defects remain, chiefly softened hierarchy, altered physical details, and added certainty or intensity. No critical defect is present.
